title: Scalar linearity of the actual common-stage pullback representative formula
statement: Fix a prime ell, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_ell and a finite coefficient field L inside Omega [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let f:X -> Y be a scheme morphism with ell invertible in every residue field of X and Y [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the rational pullback F_f,L and common-stage pullback F_f,Omega with their prescribed representative comparisons [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let P,Q be pair-category objects over Y, and let L contain both their stages. Assume F_f,L is linear over the localized coefficient ring of L. For any scalar a in that ring and any arrow r:P_L -> Q_L, the actual common-stage pullback of the representative class of a*r is heterogeneously equal to the representative class of a times the conjugate (source comparison); F_f,L(r); (inverse target comparison). All stages, stage-containment proofs and representative comparisons are the prescribed ones; no enlargement or different functor is chosen. The finite-stage scalar structure is the canonical raw scalar-localization structure inherited from integral constant-section linearity [lem-weil-integral-constructible-linear].

proof.text: Cache the named finite-stage linear structure by the actual ScalarLocalization.linear construction applied to the canonical integral constructible linear structure. This introduces no choice and agrees definitionally with the ordinary rational-stage scalar action.
Apply the specified map-on-representatives equation for commonStageDerivedPullback to the arrow a*r, using the very same finite field and stage-containment proofs.

The assumed finite-stage linearity gives F_f,L(a*r)=a*F_f,L(r). Bilinearity of composition moves a through the fixed source comparison and inverse target comparison. Congruence for the actual ofHom constructor transports this equality to the representative classes. Substitute it in the first equation.

theorem commonStageDerivedPullback_map_smul_of_linear
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y)
    (L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω) (hP : P.stage ≤ L) (hQ : Q.stage ≤ L)
    (hlin : (rationalDerivedPullback l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) f).Linear
        (Localization.Away (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L))))
    (a : Localization.Away (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)))
    (r : P.toStage hP ⟶ Q.toStage hQ) :
    HEq ((commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω f).map
        (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.ofHom P Q L hP hQ (a • r)))
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.ofHom
        (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f P) (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f Q)
        L hP hQ
        (a • ((commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f P L hP).hom ≫
          (rationalDerivedPullback l (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)
            f).map r ≫ (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f Q L hQ).inv)))
